title: Canonical moves to weekly Ubuntu kernel releases for faster CVE remediation
content_md:
Canonical is switching to weekly Ubuntu kernel releases to remediate CVE vulnerabilities faster.

via Mastodon https://linuxforeducation.blogspot.com/2026/09/canonical-trece-la-lansari-saptamanale.html
exclude_reason: Romanian blog note on Canonical weekly Ubuntu kernel release cadence; distro news, not a vulnerability, attack, breach or advisory.
